title: Hornsdale Power Reserve: Phase 56F Coverage Decision
summary: The state profile fixes current 150 MW installed power and service descriptions but not annual availability or dispatch. Phase 56F decision: No public asset-specific annual availability and dispatch series was identified; installed capacity is not a substitute.
